name: Cloudflare D1 + Access
summary: Cloudflare's D1 database for the data, and Cloudflare Access in front of /admin so staff sign in with an emailed code — no sign-in code to write.
bestFor: Sites already hosted on Cloudflare that want the simplest secure admin for a small team.
cost: Access is free for up to 50 people; D1 has a free tier.
